description.fun: Natu's wings are too small to fly, so it hops about and climbs tree trunks instead, pecking at shoots and picking food off cacti without touching a spine. Its gift for sensing what's coming makes it jumpy, and it has a habit of staring at something until that thing moves. It's tied with Rookidee as the smallest Flying-type Pokémon.
description.guide: A tiny bird Pokémon of the Psychic and Flying types whose wings are too small to fly. It is cautious and easily startled, and is said to have prophetic powers. It evolves into Xatu.
description.tagline: A tiny bird that stares at things until they move

description.fun: Xatu stands still all day watching the sun move. One theory says its right eye sees the future and its left the past, and that it stays still out of fear that what it foresees will come true. Its name comes from carved totem poles, and its X from the wish for a Pokémon for every letter of the alphabet.
description.guide: A totem-like bird Pokémon of the Psychic and Flying types, evolved from Natu. It stands motionless all day gazing at the sun, and is said to see the future with one eye and the past with the other. Its Pokédex entries tie it to South American myths.
description.tagline: A sun-watching seer with one eye on the future
